title: Drum brands, sticks and brushes
summary: Lovett lists Duplex, Leedy and Ludwig drums, plays any sticks, uses 7As, and the two talk brushes.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Well, I guess we covered that one. Baby, your first -- what brands of instruments have you played, you know, drums, and you started out with the Duplex.
-- Ludwigs. That's the first time I changed from the other two.
I don't have a favorite stick. I play with all of them. If they're light I play with them and if they're heavy I play with them.
What do you keep in your drum case?
Ludwig 7 A's. I like the 10 A, the one that's got Ray McKinley -- used to have on it anyway.
But I guess like you, I keep light sticks too in case I'm playing in a room where it's got to be real soft.
Do you use brushes very much now?
Oh yeah, you have to use brushes.
Places where you have to use them at times.
Right. We've got some gigs coming up where they want a lot of blues and ballads and I'll be using brushes all the time.
Oh yeah, that's better for that.
So right now you're using Ludwigs?
